mice treated with a neutralizing antibody to IFN-gamma failed to express detectible IFN-gamma message and developed granulomas with increased numbers of eosinophil, while mice treated with a MAb to IL-4 expressed increased levels of CD4+ T cell IFN-gamma RNA and cleared pulmonary infection.
